\section[\texorpdfstring{\ml{റാങ്ക്} (ṟāṅkŭ)}{റാങ്ക് (ṟāṅkŭ)}]{\ml{റാങ്ക്} (ṟāṅkŭ) — a rank}

\label{lesson:ML-C435-ranku}



\begin{quote}
Before the new one: say the Malayalam for a scholarship, then the Malayalam for to pass an exam.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{You'll want to know: \ml{റാങ്ക്}}
\textbf{\ml{റാങ്ക്}} — \emph{ṟāṅkŭ} — \textquotedblleft{}a rank\textquotedblright{}.

\begin{quote}
\ml{അവൾക്ക്} \ml{സർവകലാശാലയിൽ} \ml{ഒന്നാം} \ml{റാങ്ക്} \ml{കിട്ടി}.
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
\emph{avaḷkkŭ sarvakalāśālayil onnāṁ ṟāṅkŭ kiṭṭi.}
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
She got the first rank in the university.
\end{quote}

First rank is \ml{ഒന്നാം} \ml{റാങ്ക്}.

\begin{cousinweb}
\textbf{\ml{റാങ്ക്}} (\emph{ṟāṅkŭ}) was borrowed from English \emph{rank}.
\end{cousinweb}

\begin{grammarlens}[title={What you've built}]
One more word for giving reasons and opinions.
\end{grammarlens}

\subsection*{Your turn}
\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{ṟāṅkŭ}
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{ṟāṅkŭ}, once more
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{avaḷkkŭ sarvakalāśālayil onnāṁ ṟāṅkŭ kiṭṭi.} — She got the first rank in the university.
  \item \emph{Recall:} say the Malayalam for a scholarship, then the Malayalam for to pass an exam, then say \emph{ṟāṅkŭ} again
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
What does \ml{റാങ്ക്} mean? (\textquotedblleft{}A rank\textquotedblright{}.) Say it once more.
\end{tcolorbox}
\section[\texorpdfstring{\ml{ബിരുദധാരി} (birudadhāri)}{ബിരുദധാരി (birudadhāri)}]{\ml{ബിരുദധാരി} (birudadhāri) — a graduate}

\label{lesson:ML-C435-birudadhari}



\begin{quote}
Before the new one: say the Malayalam for to pass an exam, then the Malayalam for a rank.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{You'll want to know: \ml{ബിരുദധാരി}}
\textbf{\ml{ബിരുദധാരി}} — \emph{birudadhāri} — \textquotedblleft{}a graduate\textquotedblright{}.

\begin{quote}
\ml{ആ} \ml{ബിരുദധാരിക്ക്} \ml{ഇതുവരെ} \ml{ജോലി} \ml{കിട്ടിയില്ല}.
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
\emph{ā birudadhārikkŭ ituvare jōli kiṭṭiyilla.}
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
That graduate has not found a job yet.
\end{quote}

Plural: \ml{ബിരുദധാരികൾ}, \emph{birudadhārikaḷ}.

Plural: \ml{ബിരുദധാരികൾ}.

\begin{cousinweb}
\textbf{\ml{ബിരുദധാരി}} (\emph{birudadhāri}) is a Malayalam compound built from \ml{ബിരുദം}, \textquotedblleft{}a degree\textquotedblright{}, from Sanskrit \emph{biruda}, \textquotedblleft{}a panegyric, a song of praise\textquotedblright{} (Monier-Williams, under \emph{viruda}), and Sanskrit \emph{dhārin}, \textquotedblleft{}bearing, holding\textquotedblright{} (Monier-Williams): one who holds a degree.
\end{cousinweb}

\begin{grammarlens}[title={What you've built}]
One more word for giving reasons and opinions.
\end{grammarlens}

\subsection*{Your turn}
\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{birudadhāri}
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{birudadhāri}, once more
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{ā birudadhārikkŭ ituvare jōli kiṭṭiyilla.} — That graduate has not found a job yet.
  \item \emph{Recall:} say the Malayalam for to pass an exam, then the Malayalam for a rank, then say \emph{birudadhāri} again
\end{itemize}

\section[\texorpdfstring{\ml{ബിരുദദാനം} (birudadānaṁ)}{ബിരുദദാനം (birudadānaṁ)}]{\ml{ബിരുദദാനം} (birudadānaṁ) — a graduation ceremony}

\label{lesson:ML-C435-birudadanam}



\begin{quote}
Before the new one: say the Malayalam for a rank, then the Malayalam for a graduate.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{You'll want to know: \ml{ബിരുദദാനം}}
\textbf{\ml{ബിരുദദാനം}} — \emph{birudadānaṁ} — \textquotedblleft{}a graduation ceremony\textquotedblright{}.

\begin{quote}
\ml{ബിരുദദാനത്തിന്} \ml{അച്ഛനും} \ml{അമ്മയും} \ml{വന്നു}.
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
\emph{birudadānattinŭ acchanuṁ ammayuṁ vannu.}
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
Father and mother came to the graduation ceremony.
\end{quote}

\ml{ദാനം}, a giving: the giving of degrees.

\begin{cousinweb}
\textbf{\ml{ബിരുദദാനം}} (\emph{birudadānaṁ}) is a Malayalam compound built from \ml{ബിരുദം}, \textquotedblleft{}a degree\textquotedblright{}, from Sanskrit \emph{biruda}, \textquotedblleft{}a panegyric\textquotedblright{} (Monier-Williams, under \emph{viruda}), and \emph{dāna}, \textquotedblleft{}giving, a gift\textquotedblright{} (CDIAL 6265): the giving of degrees.
\end{cousinweb}

\section[\texorpdfstring{\ml{ഉന്നതവിദ്യാഭ്യാസം} (unnatavidyābhyāsaṁ)}{ഉന്നതവിദ്യാഭ്യാസം (unnatavidyābhyāsaṁ)}]{\ml{ഉന്നതവിദ്യാഭ്യാസം} (unnatavidyābhyāsaṁ) — higher education}

\label{lesson:ML-C435-unnatavidyabhyasam}



\begin{quote}
Before the new one: say the Malayalam for a graduate, then the Malayalam for a graduation ceremony.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{You'll want to know: \ml{ഉന്നതവിദ്യാഭ്യാസം}}
\textbf{\ml{ഉന്നതവിദ്യാഭ്യാസം}} — \emph{unnatavidyābhyāsaṁ} — \textquotedblleft{}higher education\textquotedblright{}.

\begin{quote}
\ml{ഉന്നതവിദ്യാഭ്യാസത്തിനായി} \ml{അവൻ} \ml{വിദേശത്തേക്ക്} \ml{പോയി}.
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
\emph{unnatavidyābhyāsattināyi avan vidēśattēkkŭ pōyi.}
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
He went abroad for higher education.
\end{quote}

\ml{ഉന്നത}, high, also makes \ml{ഉന്നത} \ml{ഉദ്യോഗസ്ഥൻ}, a senior official.

\begin{cousinweb}
\textbf{\ml{ഉന്നതവിദ്യാഭ്യാസം}} (\emph{unnatavidyābhyāsaṁ}) is built from Sanskrit \emph{unnata}, \textquotedblleft{}raised, high\textquotedblright{} (CDIAL 2099), and \emph{vidyābhyāsa}, \textquotedblleft{}the pursuit of learning\textquotedblright{} (Monier-Williams).
\end{cousinweb}

  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{unnatavidyābhyāsattināyi avan vidēśattēkkŭ pōyi.} — He went abroad for higher education.
  \item \emph{Recall:} say the Malayalam for a graduate, then the Malayalam for a graduation ceremony, then say \emph{unnatavidyābhyāsaṁ} again

\section[\texorpdfstring{\ml{മൂല്യനിർണ്ണയം} (mūlyanirṇṇayaṁ)}{മൂല്യനിർണ്ണയം (mūlyanirṇṇayaṁ)}]{\ml{മൂല്യനിർണ്ണയം} (mūlyanirṇṇayaṁ) — an evaluation; marking}

\label{lesson:ML-C435-mulyanirnnayam}



\begin{quote}
Before the new one: say the Malayalam for a graduation ceremony, then the Malayalam for higher education.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{You'll want to know: \ml{മൂല്യനിർണ്ണയം}}
\textbf{\ml{മൂല്യനിർണ്ണയം}} — \emph{mūlyanirṇṇayaṁ} — \textquotedblleft{}an evaluation; marking\textquotedblright{}.

\begin{quote}
\ml{പരീക്ഷയുടെ} \ml{മൂല്യനിർണ്ണയം} \ml{അടുത്ത} \ml{ആഴ്ച} \ml{തീരും}.
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
\emph{parīkṣayuṭe mūlyanirṇṇayaṁ aṭutta āḻca tīruṁ.}
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
The marking of the exam will finish next week.
\end{quote}

The marking of exam papers is its everyday use.

\begin{cousinweb}
\textbf{\ml{മൂല്യനിർണ്ണയം}} (\emph{mūlyanirṇṇayaṁ}) is built from Sanskrit \emph{mūlya}, \textquotedblleft{}value, price\textquotedblright{} (CDIAL 10257), and \emph{nirṇaya}, \textquotedblleft{}settling, decision\textquotedblright{} (Monier-Williams): deciding the value of a thing.
\end{cousinweb}
